name: Caustic Atlas
reason: Two growing trig arguments per pixel, plus frame-only orbital trigonometry.
recommended_mitigation: Wrap t*.7 and -t*1.4 independently; keep palette drift.

name: Voronoi Bloom
reason: Per-pixel ridge grows; seed sin/cos also grow but are computed 11 times/frame.
recommended_mitigation: Precompute -t*1.7 modulo 2pi; separately consider frame-only seed phase bounding.

name: Origami Reactor
key_expression: No sinf/cosf/ridge; time enters frac and angular folding
reason: No large-argument trigonometric performance path.
recommended_mitigation: Do not change frac/angle arithmetic under this audit; long-duration precision is separate.

name: Ink Tectonics
reason: No large-argument trig performance path.
recommended_mitigation: Exclude from trigonometric remediation.

name: Event Horizon
reason: Multiple per-pixel temporally growing sinf calls, including a nested periodic term.
recommended_mitigation: Bound -t*.8, -t*.6 and -t*2.7 separately; do not wrap entire spiral before multiplying.

name: Clockwork Cathedral
key_expression: gearPose sinf/cosf(t*...) only once per frame; per-pixel trig uses bounded angles
reason: No per-pixel unbounded temporal trig; frame-only large arguments remain.
recommended_mitigation: Consider frame-only bounding of gearPose translation oscillations, preserving gear teeth and ratios.

name: Impossible Lattice
reason: Time-growing arguments evaluated only 2 to 10 times/frame.
recommended_mitigation: Optionally bound each fold angle before frame-only trig; avoid touching fractal transforms.

name: Aether Topography
key_expression: extraSine/extraCosine use LUT by default with growing t offsets
reason: No large-input libm until LUT range fallback; LUT input precision degrades with age.
recommended_mitigation: Before multi-day use, prewrap the time-only term for each of the six LUT calls.

name: Mandelglass
reason: Frame-constant time sine remains in pixel loop and per-pixel ridge grows.
recommended_mitigation: Hoist sine(t*.18) once/frame; wrap t for ridge separately.

name: Glass Circuit
reason: Per-pixel libm sine and ridge; pseudo-random sine seed depends on drifting grid indices.
recommended_mitigation: Wrap -t*4.1 for ridge; DO NOT normalize/rewrite sin(hash) without hash-equivalence validation.

name: Aurora Loom
reason: Three growing per-pixel time terms; warp/weft trig is spatially bounded.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap t, -t*.71, t*.3 independently; preserve warp/weft coordinates.

name: Lagrange Ballet
key_expression: body orbital sin/cos evaluated 3 times/frame; ridge(potential*6) time-bounded
reason: No per-pixel temporally growing trig.
recommended_mitigation: Optionally phase-bound body angles once/frame; no change to potential contours.

name: Chromatic Kintsugi
reason: Four growing per-pixel trig terms.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap independent time coefficients and preserve frac crack/facet behavior.

name: Phantom Elevator
reason: Effective ridge phase carries t*1.1 per pixel.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap t*1.1 for ridge; leave yy for stripeY and hue unchanged.

name: Ferrofluid Theatre
reason: Per-pixel ridge grows; pole sin/cos only once/frame.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap -t*.42 before ridge; optionally bound frame-only pole orbits.

name: Riemann Current
reason: Two per-pixel ridge calls with opposite growing time phases.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap +t*1.6 once/frame; subtract/add independently, preserve logarithms.

name: Constellation Engine
key_expression: star sinf/cosf angles computed for N=11 before pixels
reason: No per-pixel temporally growing trig.
recommended_mitigation: If required, bound star orbital phase once per frame; keep star links unchanged.

name: Celestial Runewheel
reason: At least five growing per-pixel sine inputs; multiplying an angle magnifies t.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap full multiplied temporal phase per ring, NOT the base time offset before multiplication.

name: Zenith Quasicrystal
key_expression: extraCosine LUT with timePhase[k] growing for each of five axes
reason: No libm while LUT input in range; beyond 100000 radians can fall back to libm.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap five timePhase[k] before per-pixel cosine only; keep hue drift.

name: Sparse Ripple Brightness
key_expression: cosf(dist*ringWave - t*3) once per lattice dot
reason: Growing phase evaluated per lattice point, not every display pixel.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap -t*3 once/frame; ensure same shared implementation for GPT22b.

name: Sparse Ripple Size
key_expression: cosf(dist*ringWave - t*3) once per lattice dot
reason: Same phase issue as GPT21b in shared sparse renderer.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap -t*3 once/frame; keep radius modulation unchanged.

name: Photon Loom
key_expression: two sinf(spatial+t coeff), two ridge(spatial+t coeff)
reason: Four growing per-pixel trig arguments.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap t*.8,-t*.7,-t*2.8,+t*2.5 separately; keep crossing order.

name: Tidal Glyphs
reason: Growing time phases per pixel; cosf(theta)/sinf(theta) are bounded but repeated per cell.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap -t*1.8 and +t*.7; investigate per-cell reuse of theta separately.

name: Bass Cartographer
reason: Temporal sine grows even when audio is disconnected.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap -t*1.1; preserve audio state and palette.

name: Harmonic Wormholes
reason: Two growing per-pixel ridge phases.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap -t*1.6 and +t independently; preserve audio envelope.

name: Spectral Loom
reason: Two growing per-pixel phases; sine temporal frequency changes with FFT band.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap 16 band-specific phases once/frame and -t*3.4 for ridge.

name: Resonant Tessellator
reason: One growing per-pixel temporal sine via ridge.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap -t*.5 once/frame; retain e-dependent facet modulation.

name: Synaptic Reef
reason: Three growing time terms per pixel with nested sinf.
recommended_mitigation: Prewrap t, -t and -t*3 separately; outer sinf inputs remain geometry+bounded modulation.
